label: implementation-summary.md is the packet file that documents the deep-research reducer's --artifact-dir flag and its behavior: line 52 states the reducer takes --artifact-dir <path>, line 81 records the decision Exit 1 when --artifact-dir has no value, and line 93 records the verification row Missing flag value | PASS, exit 1 with [deep-research] --artifact-dir requires a path value

Three other packet files specify or track the flag without documenting its behavior: spec.md:71 lists --artifact-dir <path> on the deep-research reducer CLI in scope (deliverable at spec.md:46, SC-001 at spec.md:114), plan.md:29 and plan.md:61 name the change and the bind step that turns artifact_dir into --artifact-dir <folder>, and tasks.md:43 (T003) plus tasks.md:44 (T004) record the delegation and the exit-1 check; no packet file is a dedicated reducer CLI reference

A missing --artifact-dir value produces exit code 1, confirmed in the reducer source: lines 3154-3156 test whether the next token is absent or begins with --, write [deep-research] --artifact-dir requires a path value to stderr, and call process.exit(1); line 3159 excludes the space-separated value from the positional list so it cannot be read as the spec folder

The packet docs and the reducer source agree, including the one documented limitation: implementation-summary.md:106 says the equals form --artifact-dir=<path> is dropped with other -- tokens and the reducer falls back to the base folder, which matches the space-only args.indexOf('--artifact-dir') lookup at line 3151 and the positional filter at line 3159; the artifactDir option resolves an explicit folder when given (lines 2955-2957)
